head.b:skin: :root{--ink:#202b26;--muted:#707971;--line:#e6e8e2;--paper:#fbfaf6;--green:#385848} *{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:auto;padding:0 24px}.topline{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font:11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}.masthead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding:26px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.brand{font-size:34px;letter-spacing:-.06em;font-weight:bold}.brand span{color:var(--green)}.nav{display:flex;gap:18px;font:12px Arial,sans-serif;color:#59635c}.intro{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:center;padding:42px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.eyebrow{font:10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);font-weight:bold}.intro h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,58px);line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:13px 0}.intro p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted)}.intro-art{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:280px;background:#e9ece4;color:var(--green);font-size:70px}.posts{padding:34px 0}.posts h2{font-size:28px;letter-spacing:-.04em}.post-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px}.post-card{padding:0 0 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.post-card h3{font-size:21px;line-height:1.25;margin:10px 0}.post-card p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted)}.post-label{font:10px Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--green);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}.blogger-posts{padding:30px 0}.footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:24px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font:11px Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted)}@media(max-width:650px){.wrap{padding:0 17px}.masthead{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.nav{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:13px}.intro{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:30px 0}.intro-art{min-height:180px}.post-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}.post-card{padding:18px 0}.footer{flex-direction:column}}

div.h1: Tempat untuk menyimpan cerita yang berarti.
div.p: Ganti teks ini dengan pengantar blog, tujuan tulisan, dan topik yang ingin kamu bagikan.
